standard_prerequisites.use: The construction of the ideal sheaf of a closed immersion of algebraic spaces (Morphisms of Spaces, closed-immersion-ideals); cited input with the restriction argument written in the retained span.

core_obligations: Choose a closed subspace T of X such that i becomes a closed immersion into X minus T.
Take the quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals I defining Z on X minus T.
Verify that the restriction of I to U minus the preimage of T is the ideal sheaf of the immersion Z_U into U minus the preimage of T.
Conclude the canonical functorial identification C_{Z/X}|_{Z_U} = C_{Z_U/U}.

proof_roadmap.step: Set up the closed subspace and the defining ideal sheaf.
Check the restricted ideal computes the induced immersion and conclude the identification.

difficulty_reason: For an immersion i : Z -> X of algebraic spaces and an etale morphism U -> X with U a scheme, the lemma identifies the conormal sheaf C_{Z/X} restricted to Z_U with the conormal sheaf C_{Z_U/U}, canonically and functorially in U. The proof chooses a closed subspace T whose complement carries the immersion, takes the defining ideal sheaf I, and verifies that the restriction of I computes the induced immersion, clear from the construction of the ideal in the closed-immersion lemma. Retained author proof at lines 443-452.
